programmes.title: Engineering
programmes.description: Build a foundation in engineering, technology and practical problem-solving through laboratory work and project-based learning.

programmes.title: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
programmes.description: Strengthen your knowledge of computer applications, software development and modern computing technologies.

eligibilityIntro: Applicants should verify the current eligibility, entrance examination and admission requirements for their chosen programme.

eligibility.title: Engineering Qualification
eligibility.description: Applicants generally need to meet the prescribed educational qualifications, subjects and minimum marks for the selected undergraduate engineering programme.

eligibility.title: Engineering Entrance
eligibility.description: Applicants must meet the applicable entrance examination and merit requirements, as specified by the current admission rules.

eligibility.title: MCA Graduation Requirement
eligibility.description: Applicants need a recognised bachelor's degree and must satisfy the current subject and eligibility requirements for MCA admission.

eligibility.title: MCA Entrance Requirements
eligibility.description: Applicants must fulfil the applicable entrance examination, merit and counselling requirements prescribed for the admission year.

eligibilityNote: Eligibility rules may vary by programme and admission year. Confirm the latest official requirements before applying.

process.title: Application
process.description: Review the programme requirements and complete the applicable admission application.

process.title: Document Verification
process.description: Prepare and submit the required academic and supporting documents for verification.

process.title: Admission Confirmation
process.description: Complete the prescribed counselling, fee payment and admission formalities.
